description: This file defines a Java interface `JsonParsableRegistry` which extends `JsonParsable`. It is responsible for managing a set of `JsonParsable` types, capable of parsing objects of type `T` from JSON, and provides a method to retrieve supported types such as command, response, event, or error.

classes.name: JsonParsableRegistry
classes.description: A registry interface that manages a set of JsonParsable elements capable of parsing objects of type T from JSON. It extends JsonParsable and adds a method to retrieve the supported types (like command, response, event, error).

methods.name: getTypes
methods.description: Returns the set of string identifiers representing the types (such as command, response, event, error) supported by this registry.
